Build exactly one new app in this clean blank chat: “Cosmic Defender,” a polished, compact, responsive space-shooter game. Include keyboard movement (arrows/WASD) and usable touch controls, enemy waves, collisions, score and lives, pause/resume, game-over and restart. Add a genuine persistent top-10 leaderboard: use only a backend/database integration already supported and available in NavBharatAI; create server-side save-score and read-top-10 operations, validate/sanitize scores and display names server-side, and apply appropriate access controls. Never expose or embed secrets. Do not use localStorage or in-memory data as a claimed server database. If no actual database/backend connection is available, label the leaderboard clearly “NOT CONNECTED” and explain the exact setup needed—do not invent data or claim persistence. Use only the Weak/free engine and free in-browser preview; do not start a paid live server, publish, configure a domain, create external accounts/infrastructure, or use any paid tier. After building, run the available free preview/tests and report the actual backend/database technology and connection status.
